info.name: Eva
info.summary: AI assistant for Nextcloud with cited file search, confirmed actions and local or hosted models
info.description:
EVA brings AI into the Nextcloud workspace you already use. Ask questions about your files, get answers with source references, and prepare actions across Nextcloud for your review. Use local or hosted models and keep document search in Nextcloud's built-in SQL database.
## Work across Nextcloud
EVA is a native Nextcloud app with providers for the official Nextcloud Assistant. An administrator chooses which supported task types use EVA in **Administration → AI → Unified task processing**. Depending on your Nextcloud version and provider setup, use EVA for writing, translation, audio transcription and speech, image analysis and generation, and stickers. Scheduled tasks can also use EVA. In Files, open a document with EVA for a focused conversation. EVA can join Nextcloud Talk as an optional bot.
## Useful tools with review before changes
Use Nextcloud APIs to work with files, calendars, tasks, mail, contacts and Talk. In chat, review and confirm proposed changes before EVA applies them:
- **Files & knowledge**: search, read, create, rename, move, copy and delete files, write Markdown notes, keep a personal knowledge memory, manage shares, comments, system tags and file versions. - **Calendar & tasks**: list, create, update and delete events, find free slots, and create, complete and delete your to-dos. - **Mail & contacts**: search, list and read mails, summarize your inbox, and manage contacts and your profile. - **Talk**: list rooms, read conversations and post messages into Nextcloud Talk.
## Web search and images from the internet
EVA can search the current web for up-to-date answers and show images from the internet directly in the chat. Answers list the pages that were actually retrieved, and image results always link back to their source page.
## Choose where AI runs
Use Ollama or Groq, or configure compatible services such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek and OpenRouter. The default chat model, `gemma4:cloud`, uses Ollama Cloud. Choose a locally installed model when you want chat inference to stay on your own infrastructure. The default document index uses Nextcloud SQL; an external vector database is optional.
## Cited answers from your files
EVA extracts supported text, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files, then combines semantic and keyword retrieval. File answers include source references so you can verify them.
## Optional web search
Enable web and image search when you need current information. EVA shows the pages used for an answer and links image results to their source.
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 30–36 - PHP 8.2+ - Ollama reachable from the Nextcloud server (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434), or a hosted provider key
## Privacy
The search index is stored on your Nextcloud server. Chat prompts, retrieved excerpts and tool results are sent to the model provider you configured; the default chat model uses Ollama Cloud, so select a local model to keep everything on your infrastructure. Web search, image search, Mail, Talk and external connectors each have their own data flow and stay disabled until you enable them. EVA adds no third-party analytics.
